verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing SaaS, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Bento documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp that users connect to with their API keys, with nothing to install. Through it an agent can look up subscribers, create broadcasts and track events, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Bento Skills adds guidance on when agents should use MCP. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, detailed tool listing beyond the summary examples.
